title: zephyr.config.json
description: Per-folder configuration for ze-cli deploy: which files of an output folder are uploaded. Owner: ze-cli (SC-04).

$schema.description: Schema reference for editors. Ignored by ze-cli. Owner: ze-cli (SC-04).

version.description: Contract version of this file. Supported versions are listed here. Owner: ze-cli (SC-04).

output.description: Upload root, relative to the folder that holds this file. Absolute paths, backslashes and '..' segments are rejected. Owner: ze-cli (SC-04).

include.description: Globs, relative to the upload root, that select files to upload. Dotfiles are matched. Files that hold credentials are never uploaded, even when included. Owner: ze-cli (SC-04).

exclude.description: Globs, relative to the upload root, that remove files from the included set. Same syntax as include. Owner: ze-cli (SC-04).

target.description: Zephyr build target, with the same meaning as the --target flag. Owner: ze-cli (SC-04).

metadata.description: Path of the publication metadata JSON, relative to the folder that holds this file. Same meaning as the --metadata flag. Owner: ze-cli (SC-04).

relativeGlob.description: A picomatch glob relative to the upload root. Absolute patterns, backslashes and '..' segments are rejected. Owner: ze-cli (SC-04).
